Areas we serve

From Megara to wherever you need to go.

Tasos Pippis drives a taxi in Megara, Attica. He serves the Municipality of Megara 24 hours a day — Megara, Nea Peramos, Kineta and Alepochori — and takes you to Athens Airport “Eleftherios Venizelos”, the port of Piraeus, train and bus stations, in and out of Attica. He also delivers unaccompanied parcels and mail, hand to hand.

…and beyond: Elefsina, Athens, Piraeus, the airport, Corinth and every destination in and out of Attica, by arrangement.

What we do

Every ride, with the same care.

From the bakery around the corner to an early-morning flight: one call and Tasos is on his way.

Call now

  1. Local rides

    Within the Municipality of Megara: to work, to the doctor, to the beach, to the station or a friend’s house — Megara, Nea Peramos, Kineta, Alepochori and the villages around.

  2. Athens Airport “Eleftherios Venizelos”

    Tell us your flight time and we pick you up at your door with the margin you need. For your return, book ahead and we collect you from the airport.

  3. Port of Piraeus

    For the ferry to the islands: you reach the port on time and stress-free, together with your luggage.

  4. Train & bus stations

    Larissa Station, the Kifisos and Liosion bus stations or the suburban railway: we take you to where the next part of your journey begins.

  5. Outside Attica

    Corinth, Loutraki, the Peloponnese or further: for rides outside Attica we agree time and route in advance.

  6. Bookings in advance

    Book a day and time in advance — for early flights, appointments or business trips for your customers. We call you to confirm.

Hand to hand

Unaccompanied parcels and mail

No intermediate stops and no delays: your parcel goes from your hand… to the recipient’s hand. Ideal for documents, small parcels or urgent deliveries that need reliability and personal transport.

Questions

Good to know

At a glance

Who

What

How
Phone, WhatsApp or e-mail
Phone
697 585 7598
Are you available around the clock?

Yes. Service runs 24 hours a day, every day. For very early or late rides it is best to book in advance, so everything is arranged.

Which areas do you serve?

The Municipality of Megara: Megara, Nea Peramos, Kineta, Alepochori and the villages around. From there we take you wherever you need, in and out of Attica.

How do I book a taxi to the airport?

Call +30 697 585 7598 or send a WhatsApp message with the day, your flight time and the pick-up point. We call you to confirm and pick you up at your door.

How early should I book?

The earlier the better — especially for early-morning flights and ferries. If you need a taxi now, just call.

Do you drive outside Attica?

Yes. For rides outside Attica — Corinth, Loutraki, the Peloponnese or further — we agree time and route in advance.

Can you carry a parcel without a passenger?

Yes. Unaccompanied parcels and mail go straight from the sender to the recipient, with no intermediate stops — ideal for documents, small parcels and urgent deliveries.

Where do you pick me up?

From any point you tell us: home, work, a station, the port or the airport.

Can I send a message instead of calling?

Yes. Write on WhatsApp or to tasospippis@gmail.com — or fill in the booking form on this page and the message opens ready on your phone.
